title: What's New: Financial Management - Reminder Automation (2024 release wave 1)

features.name: Account Receivables Administrator Role Center
features.description: A new role center targeted for account receivables employees and users with navigation for posting documents in sales, reminders, reports, Excel reports, reminder process cues, automation cues, and lists of overdue balances and invoices.

features.name: Reminder Automation with Batch Jobs
features.description: Automated process for creating, issuing, and sending reminders through batch jobs. Can be set up to run manually or automatically on a schedule (weekly, monthly, or custom). Includes multiple steps: create reminders, issue reminders, and send reminders.
caveats: Can be combined into one automation or split into separate steps

features.name: Reminder Creation with Overdue Amount Filter
features.description: Reminder creation step that uses a reminder terms filter and allows filtering to include only entries with overdue amounts, excluding not-yet-due open invoices.

features.name: Reminder Automation Code Filtering
features.description: Ability to filter reminders by reminder automation code, allowing multiple jobs to generate reminders and separate issue reminder jobs to pick groups of reminders for processing.

features.name: Email Sending with Invoice Attachments
features.description: Reminders can be sent by email with option to attach referenced invoices. Users can choose to include all open invoices or only overdue invoices in the email attachment.

features.name: Automation Scheduling Options
features.description: Batch jobs can be scheduled to run weekly, monthly, on a custom schedule, or by day whenever something needs processing. Jobs can also be set to run manually.

features.name: Reminder Terms Customer Communication Setup
features.description: New card page for reminder terms with ability to customize customer communication per reminder level, including email text, subject lines, and attachment options. Each level can have different messaging and tone.
caveats: Requires feature to be turned on in feature management

features.name: Level-Based Email Customization
features.description: Each reminder level can have different email text, subject lines, and attachment options. Level one can include disregard text if customer has paid, while level two and beyond do not include this since customer has already been reminded.
